meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 专注处理 Git 操作：把多个文件的改动拆成按目录或功能区分的小提交，用 rebase/squash 整理历史，并能用 blame/bisect/log -S 查出某段代码是谁写的、何时加的。
howto.when: 当你说出“commit”“rebase”“squash”等关键词，或询问某段代码谁写的、某改动何时加入时触发。

say.text: 把这些改动按目录拆成多个提交。
say.note: 它会先分析改动并给出提交计划再执行。

say.text: 把最近 3 个提交 squash 成一个。
say.note: 触发 rebase 流程合并提交历史。
会用 git blame 定位作者。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude focuses on Git: splits file changes into several atomic commits by directory or concern, rewrites history via rebase/squash, and uses blame, bisect, log -S etc. to find who wrote code and when it was added.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "commit", "rebase", "squash", etc., or ask who wrote a line, when something was added, such as a code change.

say_en.text: Split these changes into multiple commits by directory.
say_en.note: It will analyze and show a commit plan first.

say_en.text: Squash the last 3 commits into one.
say_en.note: Triggers a rebase to merge commit history.

say_en.text: Who wrote this line of code?
say_en.note: Uses git blame to trace the author.
